# TopologyGradientDescent

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An iterative algorithm that adjusts edge weights or connectivity patterns by descending the gradient of a network performance loss function. This provides a principled method for evolving TCC architectures toward optimal communication and computation trade-offs.
